description: What ThemeValidator::validate() and ThemeResolver::valid() answer for each theme, and ThemeValidator::settings() for each site's settings, over marketplace_website@1.0.0.

cases.name: list
cases.description: A list is no theme: nothing of it is kept.

cases.name: empty
cases.description: The empty theme: nothing is wrong.

cases.name: sections
cases.description: A section a theme has not, and sections that are not maps.

cases.name: tokens
cases.description: Tokens: an unknown group and name, invalid values of each kind, a catalog color and a typography style the schema does not name, an alias to one, and a translucent color where the schema keeps it opaque (and one where it does not).

cases.name: components
cases.description: Components: an unknown component, section, variant, state and property, values of the wrong kind, an alias of another group, a level a property leaves out, a color without a default set to null, a button's colors and appearances, its sizes, a scope and slots, and colors made translucent where the schema keeps them opaque, by the node that declares them.

cases.name: visibility-images-pages
cases.description: Visibility, images and pages: unknown keys, values of the wrong kind, an unknown page and field, a footer that is no bool, sections that are no list, a section unknown, repeated, hidden that cannot be, and not `{ key, visible }`.

cases.name: modes-platforms
cases.description: Modes and platforms: an unknown mode and group, a color invalid in a mode, a translucent one where the schema keeps it opaque, an unknown platform and part, a platform's component, visibility and pages, each with what is wrong in them, and an alias to a color the schema does not name.

cases.name: platform-parts
cases.description: A platform's part that is no map, and one it has not.

cases.name: section-lists
cases.description: Sections left out of a page's list, not the last ones, also on a platform: the list kept is still a list.

cases.name: mode-colors
cases.description: A mode's colors are the schema's own, as `tokens.color`: a color of the catalog the schema does not name is unknown in a mode too.

cases.name: out-of-range
cases.description: Numbers outside their editor's limits: a token, a typography style's fields (one out, one within), a property's base, a platform's default with limits of its own and a platform's value of a property with none there, which takes its base's, refused when saved and clamped to the closest limit when read; within them, at the limits, and an alias are kept.

cases.name: out-of-format
cases.description: Numbers outside the format's range, where the editor sets no limits or within the ones it sets: an invalid number when saved, clamped to the format's range or the node's limits when read (a token of a scale, an opacity, a typography style's fields, a component's base, a group's scope, a platform's default); a layout's mode, an alias and a number that is no number of its kind (a radius) are not clamped.

cases.name: image-formats
cases.description: An image's extension is one of its formats (in any case, the query aside): the logotype takes SVG, the favicon does not, and a key without formats takes no ICO.

cases.name: image-formats-unnamed
cases.description: `jpeg` is `jpg`, and a URL without the extension of a known format says nothing of it.

cases.name: settings-invalid
cases.description: Settings: an unknown key and group, values of the wrong kind, an option it does not have, a group that is a value and a value that is a group.

cases.name: settings-out-of-range
cases.description: A setting outside its editor's limits (the franchise's id, given `min` 1 and `max` 1000 for this case): an id is not clamped, it is left out.

cases.name: settings-clamped
cases.description: Numbers of the settings (`site.max_items`, a number from 1 to 50, and `site.layout.columns`, a number without limits, given for this case): refused when saved outside their limits or the format's range and clamped when read; one within them is kept.
